transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I don’t care about the projects and hobbies I used to love anymore; nothing feels interesting to me now. I used to be so passionate about working on solar setups and being creative, but now it all just feels completely flat.
How long have you been feeling this loss of interest and flatness—has it been most days for at least 2 years, or did it start more recently?

No, it hasn't been two years, but it has been going on for a little over a year now. It really started around the time I lost a major solar contract and the financial pressure started getting really tight.
Besides losing interest, have you also been feeling down, hopeless, or depressed most days during this time?

Yes, pretty much every day I wake up with this heavy, sinking feeling in my chest, like something terrible has happened even when nothing has. It just hangs over me from my first cup of coffee until I crawl back into bed at night.
Have you also noticed changes in your sleep, appetite, energy, or concentration during this time?

Yes, I'm struggling with all of those. I lie awake for hours worrying about bills and then wake up at 3 or 4 AM unable to sleep, and I have to force myself to eat because food tastes like cardboard. My concentration is also shot—I have to reread simple emails several times and get completely frozen by basic decisions.

Did these symptoms start within a few months of the contract loss and financial stress, and do they feel mainly tied to that situation? Or do they seem to have continued even when the stress is not on your mind?

Yes, they started just a couple of months after I lost that big contract and the financial pressure hit. But now, it's become constant—even when I'm not actively thinking about the bills or the business, that heavy feeling is just there all day long.

Have these symptoms made it hard for you to work, manage daily responsibilities, or take care of yourself, and do you ever have thoughts that life is not worth living or that you'd be better off dead?

Yes, it’s severely impacted everything—I’m missing bid deadlines, turning in reports late, and letting bills pile up while my income drops and I just isolate myself at home. On the really bad nights, I do catch myself thinking it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up, or even picturing crashing my truck on the highway, though I don't have any actual plans to do anything.
Before the contract loss, had you ever had a similar period of depressed mood or loss of interest lasting at least two weeks, or is this the first time it has happened?
No, this is the first time I've ever experienced anything like this. Before the contract loss, I had never felt this level of depression or lost interest in the things I love.

Has the low mood and loss of interest been mainly a reaction to the contract loss and financial stress, or does it feel out of proportion to that stress and present even when things are otherwise going okay?

It definitely started because of the stress from losing the solar contract, but now it feels like it has taken on a life of its own. Even when nothing new has gone wrong or when I'm just trying to relax on my days off, that heavy feeling and lack of interest are there every single day. It just doesn't lift, even if the financial pressure isn't actively on my mind.
Have your symptoms improved at all as the financial and work stress has eased, or have they stayed just as severe even during periods when things were going better?

Honestly, the financial and work stress hasn't actually eased up or gotten better at all over this past year. The pressure has been completely constant, so there haven't really been any "better" periods, and my symptoms have stayed just as heavy and severe the entire time.
Have you had any period of at least a couple of weeks during this past year when your mood and interest improved noticeably, or have the symptoms been present nearly every day without relief?

No, I haven't had any break or improvement at all. Ever since I lost that solar contract a year ago, this heavy feeling and lack of interest have been there nearly every single day without any relief.

Have you had any major stressor besides the contract loss and financial pressure that could explain this, or did the depression and loss of interest begin only after that event and mainly stay tied to it?

No, there haven't been any other major stressors besides that. Everything started a little over a year ago when I lost the big solar contract and the financial pressure piled up, and these feelings of depression and loss of interest have been tied to that ongoing struggle ever since.
Have you had any period of at least two months during this past year when you felt back to your usual self, or have the symptoms been present almost every day the whole time?

No, I haven't had any periods of feeling like my usual self at all. The symptoms have been present almost every single day for the entire year. It has just been a continuous, heavy struggle without any breaks ever since I lost that solar contract a little over a year ago.

Do you feel that your symptoms are a direct reaction to the contract loss and financial stress, or do they seem to be much more intense than you would expect from that situation and hard to explain by it alone?

While it definitely started with the contract loss and financial pressure, it feels much more intense and consuming than just normal stress now. It’s like a heavy, constant cloud has taken over my whole life, making me feel completely empty, worthless, and unable to function. This feels far more severe than just being worried about bills.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months during this year when you felt back to your usual self, or have the symptoms been present nearly every day the whole time?

No, I haven't had any period like that at all. The heavy feeling and lack of interest have been present nearly every single day without any break since the financial issues started. I haven't felt like my usual self for even a few days, let alone two months.

Did these symptoms start within about 3 months of the contract loss, and do they feel mainly like an understandable reaction to that stressor rather than a persistent depression that came on independently?

Yes, they did start gradually within those first few months after I lost the contract and the financial stress hit. But since then, it has evolved into something much deeper and more persistent than just a normal reaction to stress. It feels like a heavy, constant depression that has completely taken over my life for over a year now.
Did your symptoms begin only after the contract loss and financial stress, and do they feel mainly tied to that stressor rather than coming on for no clear reason?

Yes, they definitely started only after I lost that big solar contract and the financial pressure began. It feels directly tied to those ongoing money worries and the stress of my business stalling, rather than just coming on out of nowhere.
Have you ever had a similar period of depression or loss of interest before this contract loss, even if it was less severe or lasted only a couple of weeks?
No, I have never experienced anything like this before. This is the very first time I've ever felt this way, even for just a couple of weeks.

When the financial and work stress is not on your mind, do you still feel depressed or lose interest most of the day, nearly every day? Or do the symptoms mainly come up when you are thinking about the contract loss and bills?

Yes, it is constant. Even when I'm not actively thinking about the bills or the contract, that heavy, sinking feeling is still there from the moment I wake up until I go to bed. I still can't find any spark or interest in my hobbies, even on my days off.
Have you been able to keep functioning reasonably well at work and in daily life, or has this caused a clear drop in your ability to work, manage responsibilities, or take care of yourself?

There has been a major drop in my ability to function, as I've started missing bid deadlines and turning in my repair reports late at work. At home, I'm letting chores and bills pile up, and I constantly cancel on my friends just to go straight home and sit alone. Because of all this, my income has dropped significantly and everything is slipping through the cracks.
Have you ever had any previous episodes of depression or loss of interest before this year, even if they were milder or shorter?
No, I've never had anything like this happen before this past year. This is the first time in my life that I've felt this level of depression and complete loss of interest.
Have you had any period during this time when you felt noticeably better for at least a couple of weeks, or has the depression been present nearly every day without any real relief?

No, I haven't had any periods of relief at all. This heavy feeling has been present pretty much every single day for over a year now, ever since I lost that solar contract. There hasn't been even a week or two where I felt noticeably better.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself, or any intent or plan to act on the thoughts of not wanting to wake up?

On the really bad nights when I'm looking at the overdue notices, I have thought it would be easier if I just didn't wake up, and I've even pictured crashing my truck on the highway. However, I don't have any actual plans or intent to act on those thoughts. I wouldn't actually do anything to hurt myself.
Have you started feeling depressed or losing interest even when nothing stressful is happening, or do the symptoms mainly happen in response to the contract loss and financial problems?

While it originally started with the contract loss, it has now become a constant daily presence. I feel this heavy, sinking feeling and complete lack of interest every single day, even on quiet days or days off when nothing new or stressful is happening. It just hangs over me constantly, regardless of what is going on.

Have you ever had a period of at least two months during this year when you felt back to your usual self, or have the depressed mood and loss of interest been present nearly every day without any real relief?

No, I haven't had any periods of relief or felt like my usual self at all over the past year. This depression and lack of interest have been a constant, daily struggle ever since I lost that solar contract a little over a year ago.
Did the depression and loss of interest begin only after the contract loss and financial stress, or did they start before that or seem unrelated to it?

Yes, they only started after I lost the solar contract and the financial stress began about a year ago. Before that happened, I was busy but doing really well, and these feelings only developed and got worse as the financial pressure started building up.

Have you also had any other symptoms of depression, such as feeling worthless or guilty, changes in sleep or appetite, low energy, or trouble concentrating, even when you are not thinking about the contract loss and bills?

Yes, I constantly feel like a total screwup for letting my business stall, and I'm barely sleeping or eating because my mind runs all night and food just tastes like cardboard. My concentration is also completely shot, to the point where I have to reread simple emails several times and get frozen trying to make basic, everyday choices.

Have you ever had any periods of feeling clearly better or back to your usual self for at least a few weeks since this started, or has the depressed mood been present nearly every day without any relief?

No, I haven't had any periods of feeling back to my usual self at all. Ever since the business troubles began a year ago, this heavy, depressed mood has been there nearly every single day without any real breaks. I haven't felt even a couple of weeks of relief.
Did your symptoms start within 3 months of the contract loss, and have they felt mainly like a reaction to that stressor rather than a depression that came on independently?

Yes, they definitely started within a month or two of losing that contract and the financial pressure hitting. It really felt like a direct reaction to all that stress piling up, rather than something that just came on out of nowhere.

Do you feel persistently depressed and unable to enjoy things even when the contract and money stress are not on your mind, or do the symptoms mainly come up only when you are thinking about that stress?

Yes, it is constant. Even when I'm not actively thinking about the bills or the lost contract, that heavy, sinking feeling hangs over me all day from the moment I wake up until I go to bed. I still can't find any joy or interest in my old hobbies, no matter what I'm doing.
Have you had any periods during this past year when the symptoms clearly improved for at least a couple of weeks, or have they stayed nearly constant the whole time?

No, they have been completely constant without any periods of improvement at all. Ever since I lost that solar contract and the financial stress built up, there hasn't been a single break or a time where I felt back to my normal self. It has just been a continuous weight for the entire year.
